title: The Player Who Would Not Take Gifts
description: Four weeks with a wooden sword make Weed famous for the wrong reason. The more clearly he explains himself, the less the other players believe him.
sources: Personal Mandarin adaptation of The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, fingerprinted compilation Chapter 4: four-race history compressed as context, then the training rumor and NPC misunderstanding. Stops before high-level recruitment. Branch dialogue is authored within the fixed source events.

planning.sourceBoundary: Exact pinned Chapter 4 opening through the explanation of player/NPC identity; no recruitment.
planning.dramaticChange: Weed wants uninterrupted practice; players want a special quest. He successfully refuses all gifts and states his identity, but their hopes transform his refusal into evidence. Payoff: dignity and practice preserved. Fresh problem: truth alone cannot end the misunderstanding.
